name: lemans-voice-agent
description: LeMans Entertainment AI receptionist: LiveKit voice agent, Express API and React frontend

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/setup-livekit.mjs && npm --prefix backend run download-files
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n livekit,api,agent,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "node scripts/livekit.mjs" "npm --prefix backend run dev:api" "npm --prefix backend run dev:agent" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
